text:
maria.sales: POC blocker for Newark Retail. They connected Okta app but after group push there are zero users in the tenant (newark-retail-poc). Okta log shows 204 on push. SAML assertions appear to be using NameID format 'persistent' and not including email. They also asked for a temp key to smoke test Dedicated pool throughput. cc @dan.eng @leo.se
dan.eng: 204 from Okta is ambiguous. It means our endpoint returned a 2xx, not necessarily that users were created. Can you ask for the Okta raw request/response? Also which field did they map to SCIM userName/externalId?
maria.sales: Okta mapping screenshot attached by the customer: userName = app.user.id, externalId = app.user.groupid. They said group push "works" on their side. Tenant id newark-retail-poc.
leo.se: two red flags: 1) externalId using groupid can cause duplicates across members -> our SCIM will return 409 and Okta still shows 204. 2) NameID=persistent without email makes SSO mapping fail for our login flow. We expect NameID=emailAddress or explicit email attribute.
ops-admin: checking SCIM logs now. We see repeated 409s for externalId=group_42 followed by an Okta client acknowledgement. There's also a 403 for one push where Authorization header was missing. That looks like a misconfigured outbound proxy stripping headers.
dan.eng: actionable fixes: (A) change Okta SCIM mapping to use user.login or user.email for userName/externalId; (B) change SAML NameID to emailAddress and include groups attribute if they want role sync. Provide them this example snippet for Okta mapping: {"userName":"user.login","externalId":"user.login","emails":["user.email"]}.
maria.sales: they asked if we can issue a short-lived SCIM token and also a scoped hosted key for a 2-hour Dedicated perf run. They need to validate throughput on pool dedicated-smoke-1.
leo.se: security note: for hosted trials bearer tokens are fine but never share in ticket screenshots. For Private/VPC trials we sometimes require requests from fixed IPs or mTLS. Confirm whether their environment does TLS termination at a proxy. If headers get rewritten we'll see 401/403.
ops-admin: I can create tokens: scim_tmp_nrw_48h (scoped to /scim, expires=1784696276) and infer_tmp_nrw_2h (scoped to inference:generate, pool=dedicated-smoke-1, expires=1784517320). Keys will be restricted to models=[benchmark-light]. I'll DM the secrets to Maria.
scim-helper-bot: SCIM webhook from okta.newark.example.com -> /scim/v2/Users returned 409 at 1784509955 (duplicate externalId)
dan.eng: after they swap mapping and ensure Authorization header is preserved, they should run this curl from inside their network to validate: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" https://scim.redwood-inference.example.com/scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig
maria.sales: thanks all. I'll send the tokens via DM and the Okta mapping + SAML sample to their admin. asked them to re-run group push and to capture raw req/resp if it still shows 204 but no users. I'll follow up when they confirm user creation.
leo.se: also offered to provide a SAML metadata file and step-by-step Okta guidance if needed.
maria.sales: perfect. closing for now, will reopen thread if they hit anything else. :white_check_mark:
